notes:
Smart Cuff v3.1.405 improves recording provenance and diagnostic messages.

Recordings now identify each NI acquisition task and its full-rate native signal files. NI reference fields are unavailable while acquisition is stopped. Chunk sample counts and original read times are saved, and independent task clocks remain unchanged.

Standalone protocol starts, reported settings, actual phase commands, PVR results and outcomes are retained. Manual stops cannot be mistaken for complete protocols. Recording-open settings are preserved, with close-time editor values stored separately. Installed version and source attribution no longer require Git.

SysID reports its actual startup failure before missing measurements. Repeated warnings about unchanged invalid calibration-sharing items are suppressed during a launch; every retry still validates their original bytes. Capture summaries recover from brief Windows reader locks.

Validation: 227 focused regressions, seven legacy GUI suites, 503 helper/parser/worker/analyzer assertions, clean layout and offscreen smoke checks. Original serial replay recovered all 63,383 binary samples without missing sequence values or decode errors. Four native NI recordings retained 248,650 samples without reported acquisition gaps or timestamp reversals.

Firmware remains rev27v-followup-355. Calibration, PID, pressure control and safety limits are unchanged. The software-OFF SysID execution defect requires separate firmware correction and hardware validation; this application update does not claim to resolve it.

Live deflation scoring now retains pressure and NI phase-reference indices from one read. The latest false40/F score and146-mmHg rise were reproduced by appending one recording row between two reads. Corrected growing-file and stable-file replay both give97.1/A. Unavailable phase timing remains unscored. Twenty-one phase/clock/recording tests and144 analyzer assertions passed for this addition. No clinical accuracy is inferred from the score.
